title: Inkling 2 Mini: 24-layer MoE (128 experts, top 8) looped to 48 applications, relative-bias attention with per-token sinks, NVFP4 and MXFP8 experts

installs.name: inkling2-mini-gturbo
installs.quant: native NVFP4 (layers 0-19) and MXFP8 (20-23) experts, BF16 resident weights (thinkingmachines/inkling-2-mini, repacked)
installs.note: 18 GB install: 15.7 GB packed experts, about 3.5 GB resident

installs.name: inkling2-mini-mlx4-gturbo
installs.quant: MLX conversion (mlx-community/Inkling-2-Mini-4bit, mlx-lm PR 2086): native NVFP4/MXFP8 experts, affine 4-bit g64 attention, embedding and head
installs.note: 16 GB install via repack examples/inkling2_mlx_install; not bit-exact with the BF16 install (4-bit dense weights)

installs.name: inkling2-mini-lamq54
installs.quant: LookAtMyQuant 5.4 GB release: trellis and Lloyd-Max codes native (docs/LAMQ.md)
installs.note: 6.9 GB install; multi-row passes share decode's lamq_gemv_rows, bit-exact; no dspark/ of its own (point TURBOSPARK_INKLING2_DSPARK at another install's)

installs.name: inkling2-mini-gguf-iq2m
installs.quant: GGUF AtomicChat Inkling-2-Mini-Uncensored-AD-IQ2_M (a fine-tune): IQ2_XXS gate-up, Q2_0/IQ4_NL down, Q8_0 dense
installs.note: 8.1 GB; resident experts through GPU-written blob tables; frozen GGUF memory oracle (bench/tests/inkling2_gguf_memory_oracle.rs)

installs.name: inkling2-mini-gguf-ud-iq1s
installs.quant: GGUF unsloth UD-IQ1_S: IQ1_S/IQ2_* gate-up, Q2_0/NVFP4 down

findings.workload: tslab ab --null: protocol short-explanation, 64 decode, chunk off, default slots (48, streamed); 3 clean pairs
findings.conditions: swap about 5 GB used; identical arms read a 4% order effect on 3 pairs, so a sub-5% verdict on this workload is not settled by 3 pairs
findings.note: the MAD floor (0.70%) is far below the identical-arm spread; read later verdicts against the spread

findings.workload: tslab sweep: protocol short-explanation, 64 decode, chunk off; s48@48/streamed against s96@96/streamed and s128@128/streamed; 3 clean pairs each
findings.conditions: same session as the null above; s96 is noise (record 1795273309689-65257-30); 128 slots costs about 10 GiB more slot memory and prefill read slower
findings.note: with every expert cached there are no reads, yet decode moved 3.5%: the per-application idle gaps are submit and wake latency at the 48 host syncs, not expert copies

findings.workload: tslab ab: protocol short-explanation, 64 decode, chunk off; s48@48/streamed against resident@8/streamed:TURBOSPARK_INKLING2_RESIDENT_EXPERTS=1; 7 eligible runs per arm, 0 clean pairs
findings.conditions: every pair excluded by rule: the resident arm reads no experts (no_reads) and the streamed arm does, so the page-cache classes always differ; the medians are per-arm run records, not a paired verdict; swap 8.6 GB used; built from the working tree before the resident commit, on top of 63b5e87a
findings.note: resident mode is not bit-exact with the host-routed path: GPU and host exp round differently, 19/19 tokens identical but 262/265 top-1 against llama.cpp on a 265-token prompt (the 3 misses are top-2 swaps at llama.cpp margins 0.04 to 0.19); mean KL 5.6e-4 against 7.5e-4 for the host path

open_questions: resident experts against streamed has no paired verdict: tslab pairs only arms in the same page-cache class, and the two modes never are

auto now resolves resident experts where the resident weights, the table and the 10 GiB reserve fit Metal's working set (the 36 GB M4 Max does): measure with an explicit @N/streamed arm, since a bare auto arm is resident there; a quality gate at resident exactness is still owed
the CPU reference matched llama.cpp (top-1 19/19, mean KL 4.2e-4 on 19 tokens), a correctness check, not a lab measurement (docs/INKLING2_PHASE0.md)
traps: layers 6-17 run three times per token: per-layer stats, prefetch keyed on layer + 1, and the router histogram all assume one application per layer
MXFP8 is layers 20-23, not the full-attention layers 5, 11, 17, 23
the router logits must be F32: llama.cpp runs this router in F32, and FP16 can flip a near-tie
an A/B between resident experts and any streamed arm is excluded pair by pair (page-cache class), so it always reads inconclusive
